rationale: The agent appears to have canceled the order immediately (“Your order has been cancelled and the refund is being processed”) without first authenticating the user, without confirming the order-changing action, and without exploring the user’s requested alternatives (split payment, removing the most expensive item, or switching to cheaper options). The policy requires authentication, acting only on the user’s own order, and explicit confirmation before any write. The agent also gave final information about a refund without showing any supporting tool results or confirmation. Therefore, the interaction fails the pass criteria.
